title: Social Media Star Charleston White Attacked in Barber Chair
htmlContent:
In a shocking turn of events on November 2, 2023, famous YouTuber and social media personality Charleston White was allegedly attacked by Kevin Spencer while he was asleep in a barber chair. White was on Instagram Live on his way to the hospital when he received a phone call and named Spencer as his attacker.

Earlier in the video, Charleston shared that there were two or three individuals in on the attack, but he is convertible at the establishment.

Following the attack, White was rushed to the hospital for medical attention. While his exact condition and the extent of his injuries remain undisclosed at this time, fans and supporters have flooded social media with messages of concern and well wishes for his recovery.

As the story continues to develop, supporters of Charleston White are anxiously waiting for updates on his condition and more information about the circumstances of the attack. Additionally, there is growing interest in hearing from Charleston's alleged attacker, Kevin Spencer.
